fr_html: Le PRESIDENT explique qu'il faut distinguer entre les cas vraiment juridiques et les cas d'ordre non juridique qui, à la suite d'un accord entre les parties, sont assimilés aux questions juridiques.
en_html: The PRESIDENT explained that a distinction must be drawn between real legal cases and cases of a non-legal nature, which as a result of agreement between the parties are assimilated to legal questions.
